programme.title: Raya Emas: Salako Sacred Treasure
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Sarawak, sebuah legenda kuno tentang Raya Emas telah diwarisi turun-temurun. Tapi apabila mata-mata tamak mula mengarah kepadanya, satu perjalanan yang menguji iman dan keberanian bakal terungkai.

programme.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP6
programme.desc: Madam Kwan teringat kembali kisah sebenar. Vince, anaknya, ialah pedofil yang menculik Kasyorga dan Hamdi. Uncle Lim

programme.title: Black S1 EP1
programme.desc: Detektif Khairul Malik menyimpan sebuah rahsia, yang teman wanitanya, Aisya tidak tahu mengenainya. Perkara menjadi rumit dengan penemuan mayat dua puluh tahun, yang menggerakkan rangkaian kejadian yang membawa maut. Kehidupannya berubah secara mendadak apabila dia bertemu Sofia, gadis yang berkebolehan meramal kematian orang. Apabila dia meramal sebuah tragedi dahsyat, Sofia mendapat perhatian polis dan juga seorang keturunan usahawan insurans ulung, Lokman Nazir. Tertarik dengan bakat unik Sofia, Malik meyakinkan dia untuk bekerja bersamanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa, tetapi niat baik mereka menyebabkan tragedi. Sementara itu, penghantaran sebuah pita menyebabkan huru-hara dalam hubungan Malik dan Aisya apabila rahsia gelap Aisya mula terungkai.

programme.title: Black S1 EP2
programme.desc: Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang Bunian 444 atau juga dikenali sebagai Black sedang diburu kerana rakan setugasnya seorang penderhaka, 419, telah melarikan diri ke dunia manusia. Menyedari 419 telah menghuni tubuh manusia, Black memutuskan untuk memasuki tubuh Malik untuk bersaing dengannya. Pada mata manusia, Malik telah terselamat daripada kematian dengan menakjubkan sekali dan akibat kejadian itu dia telah hilang ingatan. Dalam pada itu, Sofia mula menyedari yang Malik merupakan buat hatinya semasa kecil dan dia diselubungi rasa bersalah kerana telah meletak Malik dalam situasi bahaya. Namun Malik sekarang ialah Black - biadab, mementingkan diri sendiri dan tekad dengan satu tujuan dalam misinya. Adakah dia akan ingat siapa Sofia sebenarnya? Black mendapati dirinya berdepan dengan pembunuhan yang mengerikan semasa dia cuba mengharungi dunia manusia. Keadaan menjadi lebih rumit apabila seorang lelaki yang penuh misteri muncul dan membayangi setiap gerak-gerinya.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Black S1 EP3
programme.desc: Black mula seronok berada dalam badan manusianya. Namun menghuni tubuh badan manusia ialah jenayah Kelas A dalam dunia Bunian - Black menerima kata dua - dia mesti dapat mencari 419 atau menerima hukuman yang paling menggerunkan. Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP11
programme.desc: Cikgu Zaiton pengsan selepas ternampak lembaga seakan-akan Wan Peah di hadapan rumah Cikgu Siti semasa pulang dari kedai. Tok Hashim kemudiannya mengadakan sembahyang hajat dan doa selamat. Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton tidak habis-habis menyalahkan Cikgu Siti yang kononnya memakai menyebabkan huru-hara di kampung mereka. Selepas solat hajat, Nurin yang merasa bersalah mengaku dialah yang menakut-nakutkan Cikgu Zaiton pada malam tersebut. Farhan semasa berkelah dengan Cikgu Siti dan 3 sahabatnya di Bukit Berapit mendapati Aishah tiba-tiba hilang.

programme.title: The Equalizer S1
programme.desc: Mel menyamar sebagai sukarelawan untuk seorang ahli politik yang semakin meningkat naik ketika McCall cuba membantu seorang pelajar kolej yang tertekan selepas diancam oleh seseorang dari dalam kempen calon tersebut. Selain itu, McCall mula risau apabila Delilah berkawan dengan seorang gadis muda yang pernah dipenjarakan di pusat tahanan juvana, mengingatkannya kepada masa silamnya yang penuh masalah.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: Saranjana Kota Ghaib
programme.desc: Apabila Sitha, penyanyi utama kumpulan terkenal hilang, kumpulan itu meneruskan pencarian, mengetahui bahawa Sitha berada di Saranjana, sebuah bandar ghaib, dan untuk membawanya kembali, mereka mesti mencari portal melalui pengembaraan peristiwa mistik.

programme.title: Unhuman
programme.desc: Semasa keluar berkhemah, San dan rakan-rakannya dari sekolah menengah merakam gambar meteor yang terhempas. Gambar itu mengandungi petunjuk kematian seorang saintis yang menjalankan kerja eksperimen dengan organ manusia dan kemungkinan kaitan dengan ahli sihir Kemboja.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Black S1 EP3
programme.desc: Black mula seronok berada dalam badan manusianya. Namun menghuni tubuh badan manusia ialah jenayah Kelas A dalam dunia Bunian - Black menerima kata dua - dia mesti dapat mencari 419 atau menerima hukuman yang paling menggerunkan. Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Darah Satria

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Father Son
programme.desc: Iman, seorang remaja, menjaga bapanya yang sakit. Selepas bapanya meninggal dunia, roh bapanya kembali untuk membantunya menghadapi sekolah, masalah buli, dan kehidupan cinta.

programme.title: Srimulat Hidup Memang Komedi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan awal kumpulan komedi legenda Indonesia, Srimulat, yang berhijrah dari Solo ke Jakarta untuk mengejar impian mencipta nama. Dalam usaha mencapai kejayaan, mereka berdepan pelbagai cabaran, pengorbanan dan konflik, namun terus menghiburkan penonton dengan jenaka dan semangat yang tidak pernah luntur.

programme.title: Reaksiar

programme.title: Adnan Sempit Sawadikap
programme.desc: mengisahkan Adnan Shaheizy Sam yang lucu, bersama isteri dan anaknya, memulakan perjalanan ke Thailand bersama sahabat baik mereka, Bobby dan Wawa, di mana pelbagai lagi pengembaraan menanti.

programme.title: Adnan Sempit Generasi Gig
programme.desc: Selepas menyelamatkan Nadia Afifah Nasir, seorang wanita moden yang telah lama diminatinya, Adnan Aiman Tino, seorang penghantar makanan, mula jatuh cinta tanpa menyedari bahawa dia mungkin terperangkap dalam rancangan tersembunyi wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Temen Kondangan
programme.desc: Putri yang sering menghadiri majlis perkahwinan seorang diri akhirnya menyewa seorang lelaki untuk menjadi teman menghadiri majlis. Namun, hubungan yang pada mulanya sekadar lakonan bertukar menjadi lebih rumit apabila perasaan sebenar mula muncul.

programme.title: 7 Days24 Hours
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pasangan suami isteri, Tania dan Tyo, yang terlalu sibuk dengan kerjaya sehingga hubungan mereka semakin renggang. Selepas kedua-duanya jatuh sakit dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital yang sama, mereka akhirnya mempunyai masa bersama selama 7 hari 24 jam untuk memperbaiki hubungan, memahami satu sama lain dan menghadapi masalah yang selama ini dipendam.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Diari Abah
programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.

programme.title: Srimulat Hidup Memang Komedi

programme.title: Reaksiar

programme.title: 99 Nama Cinta

programme.title: Ruang Temu

programme.title: Perjodohan Mengundang Teror

programme.desc: Tari dan Andre adalah pasangan suami isteri yang bahagia. Namun, kedatangan sahabat Tari menyebabkan masalah dan konflik dalam rumah tangga mereka. Persahabatan itu mula mengancam kebahagiaan rumah tangga mereka.

programme.title: Superstar Junior
programme.desc: Superstar Junior Indonesia ialah pertandingan bakat kanak-kanak yang disiarkan di Mentari TV. Rancangan ini menampilkan peserta cilik dari seluruh negara yang menunjukkan bakat dalam nyanyian, tarian dan lakonan untuk memikat hati juri dan penonton.

programme.title: THE ATTORNEY
programme.desc: When tax attorney Song Woo-Suk agrees to defend a student activist who was arrested and tortured into giving a false confession, his entire life and worldview begin to change drastically.

programme.title: ONCE WE WERE US ((後來的我們))
programme.desc: Former lovers Eun-ho and Jeong-won unexpectedly reunite on a flight to Korea, giving them a second chance to reminisce about their past and share long-buried words with each other. (让他们有第二次机会回想起自己的过去, 并彼此分享长久的言辞。)

programme.title: OMNISCIENT READER: THE PROPHECY ((全知读者视角))
programme.desc: Dok-ja is the only reader of an obscure web novel for 10 years. Suddenly, the apocalyptic world of the novel becomes reality. He and the novels omnipotent hero strive to save the world. (东贾是10年来唯一读过一个模糊的网络小说的读者.突然间,小说的末日世界成为现实.他和小说的全能英雄努力拯救世界.)

programme.title: VICTORY ((圣罗 Victory))
programme.desc: In 1999, Pil-sun and Mi-na team up with cheerleader Se-hyeon to form the cheerleading team Millennium Girls with seven other girls for their high school soccer team, aiming for victory. (1999年,皮尔孙和米娜与啦啦队长谢合作,为他们的高中足球队组成了"千一代女孩"啦队队,)

programme.title: MIDNIGHT RUNNERS ((青年警察：午夜跑者))
programme.desc: Two students from Korean National Police University decide to work together and track down a kidnapping incident. (两名韩国国家警察大学的学生决定一起追踪绑架事件.)

programme.title: THE WITCH: PART 2. THE OTHER ONE ((魔女2))
programme.desc: A mysterious girl survived a blood raid in a secret lab found herself being tracked down by a group of assassins. (一个神秘的女孩在秘密实验室的血检中幸存下来 发现自己被一群刺客追踪)

programme.title: INSADONG SCANDAL ((仁寺洞丑闻))
programme.desc: A painting is discovered after 400 years. It could fetch 40 million in the auction market once restored. The curator and a restoration artist unveil its true form and secrets behind... (四百年后才发现一幅画,一旦恢复了 就可以在拍卖市场上得到四千万)

programme.title: THE LOST CHOICES (失去的选择)
programme.desc: A young woman who has speech disorder is raped while on her way home. The police do not believe in her. She is frustrated and thus triggers her silent revenge against the world. (一位有言语障碍的年轻妇女在回家的路上被强奸,警察不相信她,她沮丧,因此引发了对世界的无声报复。)

programme.title: HANDSOME GUYS ((星期天帅哥))
programme.desc: Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-Pil and sexy guy Sang-Gu move to a countryside home. A spirit sealed in the basement awakens, leading to a high-stimulus chilling comedy theyll never forget. (简介:自称的强硬男孩杰皮尔和性感男孩桑格格搬到乡村家园.)

programme.title: LOVE RESET ((爱情重置))
programme.desc: A couple decide to divorce after two years of marriage. They revive a 30-day divorce settlement period from the court, but then they both lost memories after a car accident... (两年结婚后,一对夫妇决定离婚,他们恢复了30天的离婚和解期限,)

programme.title: MY DAUGHTER IS A ZOMBIE ((我和我的僵尸女儿))
programme.desc: Jung-hwans daughter, Soo-ah, is infected with a zombie virus. He notices that she still seems to understand words, so he draws on his experience with animal training to guide his zombie daughter. (Jung-whans女儿Soo-ah感染了僵尸病毒。他注意到她似乎仍然能理解语言,因此他吸取了动物训练的经验来指导他的僵尸女儿。)

programme.title: EXHUMA ((破墓))
programme.desc: Exhuma follows two shamans, a feng shui expert and an undertaker as they seek to help a Korean-American family tormented by an ancestral curse. (埃克舒马跟着两个巫师,一个士师和一个葬礼员,)

programme.title: PILOT ((宋旻浩的Pilot))
programme.desc: Han Jung-woo is a popular star pilot. He is unable to work in any company due to a momentary mistake. He later gets a job with his sisters identity but his new job is soon threatened. (汉正宇是一位受欢迎的星级飞行员,由于短暂的错误,他无法在任何公司工作。 后来他得到了一份具有姐妹身份的工作,但他的新工作很快受到威胁。)

programme.title: HOPELESS ((无奖竞猜))
programme.desc: Yeon-gyu has never gotten what he wanted in life. With Chi-geons help, he joins the gang and struggles to hold on to hope, but soon finds himself facing even more dangerous situations. (-从来没有得到他想要的东西. 凭借奇帮的帮助,他加入了帮派,并努力坚持希望,)

programme.title: TRAIN TO BUSAN ((釜山行))
programme.desc: While a zombie-virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers including a father and young daughter, a couple, and several students struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan. (在韩国爆发尸病毒时,乘客包括父亲和小女儿,一对夫妇和几名学生在于在首尔到布山的火车上扎.)

programme.title: A TAXI DRIVER ((出租车司机艳遇记))
programme.desc: A widowed father and taxi driver takes a German reporter from Seoul to Gwangju to cover the 1980 uprising. (一个寡妇父亲和出租车司机将一位德国记者从首尔带到广州报道1980年起义.)

programme.title: HARBIN (哈本)
programme.desc: In 1908, Ahn Jung-geun and Korean independence fighters win against Japanese army. A year later, they head to Harbin as the Japanese statesman Uto Hirobumi is going for negotiation... (1908年,安军和韩国独立战士赢得了日本军队.一年后,他们前往哈尔,)

programme.title: ACTIONHERO ((动作英雄))
programme.desc: A college student dreaming to be an action star discovered an admission fraud. He decided to make an action film of him against the corrupted professor. (一位梦想成为动作明星的大学生发现了招生欺诈行为,)

programme.title: ESCAPE FROM MOGADISHU ((摩加迪沙))
programme.desc: The ambassadors from North and South Korea in Somalia must join hands to escape from war-torn Somalia. (来自南北朝鲜的驻索马里大使必须携起手来,逃离饱受战争蹂躏的索马里。)

programme.title: THE LIMIT ((惊爆死亡线))
programme.desc: Policewoman So-eun stands in as the mother of a kidnapped child. The kidnpaper demands to negotiate with her as So-eun and not as the stand-in for the kidnapped childs mother... (女警素恩作为被绑架孩子的母亲站在那里。)

programme.title: Fresh Off the Sea 3 ((姐姐家的产地直送 3))
programme.desc: The cast travels to new locations to experience seaside life, working at local jobs and cooking authentic meals with fresh, seasonal ingredients in this heartwarming reality show. (演员们前往新的地方, 经历海生活, 在当地工作,)

programme.title: Space Rice Cake ((宇宙年糕店))
programme.desc: A spin-off of Earth Arcade where the members reunite to run a rice cake shop, showcasing their unique chemistry and variety show charm in a brand-new setting. (后者是"地球大"的衍生品,成员团结起来经营一家饼店,)

programme.title: Space Rice Cake ((宇宙年糕店))
programme.desc: A spin-off of Earth Arcade where the members reunite to run a rice cake shop, showcasing their unique chemistry and variety show charm in a brand-new setting. (后者是"地球大"的衍生品,成员团结起来经营一家饼店,)

programme.title: Fifties Professionals ((大叔再出招))
programme.desc: Three once-pros get one last chance to rebootfinally starting the real second half of their lives in their fifties (3个一对一对一的 获得最后一次机会 最终重新开始 开始他们50多岁时的下半生)

programme.title: GBRB spinoff: Cafeteria Operation ((豆豆饭饭))
programme.desc: Lee Kwang-soo and Doh Kyung-soo are reuniting to open a cafeteria inside the production company eggiscoming. What kind of meals will they prepare using the newly harvested potatoes from 3 Meals A Day: Light ? (Lee Kwang-soo 和 Doh Kyung-soo 正在重新团结起来,在生产公司内开一家餐厅。 他们准备用三餐后新收获的土豆做什么饭? 光?)

programme.title: Abra-ca Empty: The Weight We Share (Abra-ca 空: 我们共享的重量)
programme.desc: Four travelers embark on a two-week journey to four destinations with just one shared suitcase, turning every packing choice into a challenge, compromise and adventure. (四名旅行者前往四个目的地,为期两周,只有一个共用的手提箱,将每一个包装选择变成挑战、妥协和冒险。)

programme.title: Walking Through The Village ((中文))

Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today ((剥茧 Whats On Today))
programme.desc: Haunted by his girlfriends suspicious death in a car crash, young forensic examiner Qi Sizhe transfers to a major crimes unit to find the truth. (年轻的法医奇思哲(Qi Sizhe)以他的女友们在车祸中疑似死亡为借口,将他转到一个重大犯罪股寻找真相。他与侦探朱青雨和韩峰警官合作,调查了一系列奇怪的谋杀事件。通过法医证据,他们发现每一个犯罪都与一个非法合成毒品团伙有关,这个团伙名叫“原钻石集团 ” 。)

programme.title: Her Railway Trip (她的铁路旅行)
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures Sr.7 (邻居财库)
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. Each episode features celebrity guests divided into two teams, each using their imagination to solve incredibly difficult puzzles related to the hilarious clips alongside the leader. They can also ask two beautiful fun agents for hints, but theyll have to judge for themselves which information is true and which is false. The worst-performing guest will receive retraining from the leaderwhat punishment awaits the guests? (Sammy和Kitty,这个在屏幕上重聚的Camimy和Kitty,这个在屏幕上重聚的,这次是秘密特工头目,从台湾、日本和香港向观众提供热闹的剪辑。每集的主角都是名人宾,分成两队,各利用他们的想象力解决与领导人一起的滑稽剪辑有关的极其困难的谜题。他们也可以请两个美丽的有趣的代理人提供提示,但他们必须为自己判断哪些信息是真实的,哪些是虚假的。最差的客人会从领导人那里得到什么惩罚?)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))

In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today ((剥茧 Whats On Today))

programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Table for Six 2 ((还是觉得你最好2))
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved. (布纳德和在婚礼期间结婚,但婚礼却变成了混乱的战场,家庭剧情不断升级,为所有参与者造成混乱的事件.)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive? (在愤怒和悲痛的驱使下,他们开始一场无序的暴力斗争,以追击残酷的贩运集团。 他们能摧毁犯罪团伙,让孩子活着回家吗?)

programme.title: The Phantom Lover ((夜半歌声))
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from Tos father and bitter jealousy from her designated fianc, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community. (1926年,中国有才华的歌手宋英俊深爱着来自富裕家庭的可爱的无辜女孩托,他们的爱激起了托斯父亲的强烈反对,也引起了她指定的未婚夫的强烈嫉妒,未婚夫是她家庭所选择的一位年轻男子。 这是一个关于一名歌手和一个富人女子在传统社区中争吵在一起的故事。)

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown ((意外人生))
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap (潘仪明的父亲会收到父亲的来函,说他必须在家里参加葬礼,以获得巨大的遗产。当他回家时,他遇到了他的前女友、她的丈夫华琦和女儿,而他从未见过她们。 当潘仪明发现他的女儿被华婆虐待时,他发誓要救她,但最终会落入他们的陷阱。)

programme.title: Tainted Love ((无法抗拒的爱))
programme.desc: Office lady Zhou Ran falls victim to an online dating love scam and is cheated of 550,000 yuan. Following faint clues left by the scammer, Zhou Ran comes to a small coastal town and encounters two young men. She gradually discovers that these two men have hidden the clues of the scam, and sets out on her revenge plan. (办公室的Zhou Ran女士成为网上约会爱情骗局的受害者,并被550,000元骗骗。 在骗徒留下微弱线索后,Zhou Ran来到一个小沿海城镇,遇到了两个年轻人。 她逐渐发现这两个男人隐藏了骗局的线索,并提出了她的报复计划。)

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette ((手卷烟))
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live together, the two men transcend conflicts and cultural differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood. (一位退休的英中士兵在抓走一个携带一袋被盗毒品的南亚青年男子时成为三合会追捕的目标。 两人被迫共同生活,他们超越冲突和文化差异,在这个充满忠诚和兄弟情谊的壮观故事中形成美丽的友谊。)

programme.title: Silent Code ((沉默代码~监狱的密约~ - 百度百科))
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem... (兰记者的任务是研究互联网新闻, 并穿越BBS热门论坛,梦想董事会。论坛创始人项项为网民分享梦想和想法创造了空间, 但最终却因视频泄露而成为激烈辩论的主题。 兰记者为真相挖掘真相时, 她发现事情比看上去复杂得多。)

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords ((扫毒2：天地对决))
programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau and Louis Koo, the two award-winning best actors star on opposing sides of a drug war. As a bounty of 100 million Hong Kong dollars is made to hunt down the biggest drug dealer in the city, Hong Kong becomes the battleground for the fight between good and evil. (在这场史诗般的表演中,刘刘华和高路易(Louis Koo)是获奖的两位最佳演员,在一场毒品战争的对立面上出演。 由于一亿港元的赏金被用来追捕本市最大的毒贩,香港成为了正义与邪恶斗争的战场。)

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan ((前任4：英年早婚))
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a marriage cooling-off period to tackle marriage issues. (孟云和优飞这两个兄弟已经到了适婚年龄,在恋爱中面临挑战。 云在分手后逃避家庭结婚的压力,而飞及其女朋友选择婚姻冷却期来解决婚姻问题。)

programme.title: The Sleep Curse ((乱马½))
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, a young translator colluded with the enemy and was cursed by a murdered comfort woman. Forty five years later, the translators son who is a professor specializing in sleeping disorder does not believe in the sleep curse on his father and tries to dispel it with a horrifying sleep experiment. (在日本占领香港期间,一位年轻的翻译与敌人勾结,被一位被谋杀的慰安妇诅咒。 四十五年后,一位专门研究睡眠障碍的翻译儿子不相信他父亲的睡眠诅咒,并试图用可怕的睡眠实验来消除这种诅咒。)

programme.title: Song Of Spring ((乱马½))
programme.desc: An 85-year-old mother lives with her 65-year-old daughter who is suffering from Alzheimers disease, causing her to suffer a decline in memory, mental confusion and disorientation. Though the elderly mother has to shoulder the burden of a caregiver, she still wants to be with her daughter forever. (一位85岁的母亲和65岁的女儿住在一起,她患有阿尔茨海默病,导致她的记忆力衰退,精神混乱和失导.)

programme.title: Stuntman ((特技替身演员))
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friends final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter. (李森被弃的作导演在导演朋友的最后电影中被提供作战舞蹈演员的角色.带着雄心勃勃的年轻作员,两代冒着一切的风险来舞台上回归. 李森正与他的激烈气质和过去的错误作斗争,他也努力修复与他疏远的女儿的关系.)

programme.title: Demi-Haunted ((魂魄唔齐))
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Feis ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish (Wan Fei是一位有前途的中国歌剧歌手,他暗中爱上了一位名叫江峰的人。她想为他唱歌,但死于一场悲剧性事故。 几年后,Wan Feis的鬼魂回来了,发现她的精神的一部分已经以中国年轻歌剧歌手Chor Bai的形式转世。 这终于让Wan Fei实现了她的愿望。)

programme.title: Love Lies ((血爱成河))
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica downloads a dating app for fun. Little does she know that the charming French engineer on the other end is actually a local con artist named Joe, who is a member of an online scam group. As their fake relationship unfolds, both Joes guilty conscience and Veronicas hopes intensify. (维罗妮卡(Veronica)的妇科医生下载了约会应用软件来取乐。她不知道另一端迷人的法国工程师其实是一个名叫Joe的本地骗子。 Joe是网络骗局集团的成员。 随着他们假关系的发展,Joes的内疚和Veronicas都希望加强。)

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell ((扫毒3：人在天涯))
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchats drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust (香港警察Billy在Suchats贩毒集团卧底工作,而另一个卧底警察联翼成功地赢得了他们对一起事件的信任,并在三者之间建立起了兄弟关系。 当警察查封了黑帮时,Suchat和Billy逃到金三角,在信任圈内得到关于背叛的举报。)

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 2009 ((家有喜事2009))
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Yu Chu has no chance of finding a husband with her insufferable personality, much to the consternation of her younger brother Yu Bo, who due to a curse, will fail in love until his sister gets married. Yu Bo hires a love expert, Dick, to woo his sister. Smitten at first sight, Yu Chu is not about to let Dick get away... (成功的女商人Yu Chu没有机会找到一个有她无法忍受的个性的丈夫,这在很大程度上令她弟弟Yu Bo感到惊恐,Yu Bo由于受到诅咒,在姐姐结婚之前会失去爱。Yu Bo聘请了一位爱专家Dick去追他的妹妹。一眼就发现,Yu Chu不打算让Dick逃跑。)

programme.title: A Legend ((征服世界盃：梅西的傳奇之路))
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together. (考古学家方教授在一次冰川探险中发现了一些文物,这些文物与他的梦中一颗玉冠相似。 为了揭示真相,方教授带领他的团队前往冰川,一起踏上了一场奇妙的冒险。)

programme.title: Welcome to My Side ((欢迎来到我身边))
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways. (陈小周在痛苦的分手和奇特的事故后,被一群只有他能看见的摇摇晃晃晃的橡皮鸭缠住了。 每当他和欢乐的冯佳南在一起时,他的怪咒就会消失。 随着他们的亲近,一个荒谬而又令人心动的浪漫花花,以出乎意料的方式改变了他们的生活。)

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant ((摇篮凡世))
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope. (在一个保守的社会中,一个从未关闭的婴儿孵化场引发激烈的道德争议和公众反弹。 尽管批评和压力越来越大,莱苏、法蒂玛、卡姆杰和努鲁仍然坚定地履行保护绝望母亲的使命,没有别的地方可去,同时为被遗弃的新生儿提供脆弱的生活和希望机会。)

programme.title: Iceman ((冰人))
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise. (被错误指控谋杀的明朝卫兵英被三兄弟追赶,直到一场激烈的战斗使四人被冰封。 四百年后,他们在现代香港觉醒,在那里他们必须在一个他们几乎无法辨认的世界重现其古老的世仇。)

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall ((王昭君))
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself. (王赵军拒绝贿赂帝国画家,因此他画了一张她丑陋的肖像,阻止她被皇帝选中,直到他们见面。 画家最终流亡在外,并阴谋让王朝嫁给洪军阀,以报仇。 皇帝拒绝了这一提议,挑起一场战争,只有王王自祭才能避免战争。)

programme.title: Love Parade ((璇宫艳史))
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love (时装设计师史诗请他的朋友梅美评论他的新设计,但因她的批评而愤怒。 当穆伊要求他为她设计一件礼服参加一场盛会活动时,史美通过制作小丑服装进行报复。 看到米丝尴尬,史美感到内疚,在恋爱前向她道歉。)

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother ((书剑恩仇录))
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles (皇帝强龙并非生来王位的合法继承者,但他只有在两个颠覆性反政府秘密组织的高级成员多年后与他联系时才知道真相。 诚如事实,这个组织的主管是秦龙的弟弟,他们现在必须相互对抗,扮演对立的角色。)

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee ((新陈三五娘))
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide. (黄梅歌剧情中的奇怪标题是指两个道具,表明学者和当地美女之间有一个幸福的开始.学者抛光镜子,以接近他的爱情,谁通过扔一些子来表示她的认可.从那时起,他们的爱情变得摇滚,满满谋杀和自杀.)

programme.title: The Fastest Sword ((天下第一剑))
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally? (南剑客丁(Southern Swordsman Ting)名为“最快之剑 ”, 但却被街头和尚打败,必须履行他的承诺,在与和尚一起渴望的石碑上工作三年。 之后,丁回到家乡过着和平的生活,并减少了所有挑战。 即使如此,他还是被迫与北剑侠作战。谁能最终获胜?)

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung ((乾隆下江南))
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter. (龙皇帝不知名地前往江南审查他人民的生计,但很快发现腐败官员正在压迫他的人民.皇帝遇到了一个正直的年轻人,他们携手教腐败官员一个教训.年轻人被任命为他的保卫.)

programme.title: The Deadly Duo ((双侠))
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive. (宋朝的王子被钦族入侵者抓获,由武术大师顶尖看守。 有两个强大的爱国者需要克服巨大的困难,拉出不可能的:拯救王储并活着离开钦族据点。)

programme.title: Sweet And Wild ((野姑娘))
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back? (是一个的村子女孩,她不怕反击暴徒.她遇到了最大的子的麻烦,当她与女仆打败他的计划时,让策划复仇.)

programme.title: The Dragon Creek ((龙虎沟))
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer. (这部Wuxia谋杀神秘片讲述了一位年轻女孩的父亲在中国早期共和时代遭到无情谋杀。 她有一张恶棍的名单,他们一直在密谋反对她的父亲,并且与她的哥哥一起,这位年轻女孩开始寻找秘密的连环杀手。)

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again ((乌龙济公))
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins. (活佛吉骨和不朽的Lu Dong Bin沉浸在凡人世界中,数名妇女的命运引发了一场争斗。 当这两个神灵在三次奇特的竞赛中展示其力量时,一系列可笑的不幸事件发生了。 在浪漫纠缠中,不朽者和人类之间开始了一场史诗般的战斗。)

programme.title: Heads For Sale ((女侠卖人头))
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge. (胡是一位正直勇敢的剑士,她会为她爱的罗罗做任何事情.当罗罗被腐败警察送入监狱时,她开始释放他,并毫不犹地砍下两名保卫人的头部.在这个过程中,她也遇到了父亲的老敌人,他回来寻求报复.)

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess ((万花迎春))
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance. (贝蒂在一个舞蹈团中担任主角舞蹈家,并申请成为一位富有的女孩贝蒂的司机.当传言说他是她的情人时,贝蒂生气,并作为一名报道员来调查谣言.他们在这个过程中恋爱,经过许多测试后,他们最终用舞蹈封闭了他们的爱情.)

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu ((黄飞鸿义取丁财炮))
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hungs relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhous favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission? (沈和飞关系变得酸,沈将和他的门徒谋杀.他们被商人周救了,但必须赢得狮子舞奖,以回报周的好处.飞能击败所有熟练的武术艺术家并完成他的任务吗?)

programme.title: House of Traps ((House of 青出于蓝s))
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house... (邪恶的王子把被盗的帝国宝藏藏在一个充满了诱杀刀片的房子里。 在等离子清除攻击中,英雄和流氓试图揭开房子的致命秘密...)

programme.title: The Mighty One ((后院活宝))
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors... (龙龙寻找五卷著名的功夫手册,以获得不可战胜力。当他相信武术师傅拥有这本书时,他杀死他和他的女儿,但留下一个弟弟妹妹。 几年后,龙龙输了两卷,又开始了另一次血腥狩猎,但每次尝试都被两个神秘的战士打断...)

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World ((武林圣火令))
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chous parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents deaths. (天的父母被一对火焰状刀子杀害.他和他的姐姐被英雄和恶棍分别救援,抚养和训练,每个继承了刀子中的一个.起初他们宣誓敌人,最终揭露了他们的真实身份,并联合起来报复父母的死亡.)

programme.title: The Purple Shell ((紫贝壳))
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end? (Hui和Ha被困在他们不愉快的婚姻中,当他们在聚会上见面时互相吸引。在他们的一个海滩漫步中,Ha拿起一个紫色的贝壳,把它交给Hui作为纪念物。当Hui的丈夫发现这些壳壳时,他伤害了Hui,让她病得很重,同时也敲诈Ha。这个爱情故事会如何结束呢?)

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers ((街市英雄))
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends. (少林的洪西关被逃到清廷的武术败类追赶受伤,他被来自湿市的朋友救治,他们把洪光藏在豆腐店里保护他,但香港敌人发现他,在店里伏击他,希望抓住洪光和他所有的朋友。)

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan (铁扇公主)
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master. (唐三藏及其门徒被火烈山阻挡,只有铁扇公主的粉丝才能扑灭火焰。 被公牛魔王及其妻子拒绝的孙武康必须赶过他们才能得到火烈山。 穿越后,他们落入白骨魔姐妹的陷阱,而武贡必须利用他的力量来救他的主人。)

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master ((洪拳大师))
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium houses owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet. (泰广东虎队长铁桥三是一位有众多门徒的光荣大师。 随着鸦片在贵族中越来越受欢迎,铁桥开始吸食鸦片并逐渐伤害他的身体。 当鸦片屋主在战斗中击败铁桥,他只能免于被门徒杀害时,铁桥发誓戒除鸦片并重新站起来。)

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer ((猎人))
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else? (Tycoon Zhou是一个订婚的花花公子,但这并不阻止他尽可能多地对女士施展魅力。 他有一本关于他浪漫的幻想的日记,很快,他所亲密的女子就被一对一地杀害。 周成为警方的头号嫌疑犯,但凶手是另一个人吗?)

programme.title: Brothers Five ((兄弟 Five))
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang. (5个自出生以来分离的考兄弟不知道邓龙庄主杀死了他们的父亲。 然而,所有5个兄弟都因为欺凌而发誓打败庄园里的恶棍。 在重新团结、纪律严明和辛勤工作之后,高山准备面对龙及其帮派。)

programme.title: Lovers Blades ((神经大侠))
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed. (将把一对不可战胜的武器 " 刀锋 " 交给清皇,但意外落入小中惠和元光南之手,于是皇上卓天雄就把他们捉拿下来,在战斗开始时,刀剑的秘密也暴露出来。)

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu ((南拳蔡李佛))
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wongs disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples. (著名的功夫大师黄飞鸿在广东教武术。 一个恶毒的黑帮阴谋要伤害黄徒门徒,陷害他抢劫和谋杀。 王王必须对抗罪犯以证明他无罪并报复门徒。)

programme.title: Katteri
programme.desc: Treasure-seeking crooks venture to a hillside village for gold but are unprepared for the mysterious and astonishing sights they encounter.

programme.title: Nenjam Marappathillai
programme.desc: Mariam, a woman raised in an orphanage, is offered a job as a caretaker for a child from a rich family. However, she is sexually exploited by her employer and returns as a spirit to exact revenge.

programme.title: Adhe Kangal
programme.desc: Varun Murali, a restaurant owner, falls in love with his customer Deepa. However his life takes an unusual turn after he realises the truth about her.

programme.title: India Pakistan
programme.desc: Two aspiring lawyers, not knowing that both are of the same profession, share the same office. Things take a turn when they work on the same case.

programme.title: Rummy
programme.desc: College students Shakthi and Joseph fall for sisters. Family discovers, sparking a battle to protect honor. Love, loyalty, and sacrifice collide in a fight for respect and tradition.

programme.title: Wild Dog
programme.desc: A series of deadly attacks occur that pose a threat to national security. In response, a brash but brilliant intelligence agent leads a covert operation to find the perpetrators.

programme.title: Irumbu Thirai
programme.desc: A military officer borrows money for his sisters marriage using fake papers. When the money goes missing from his account, he embarks on an investigation that uncovers a hacker.

programme.title: Nerkonda Paarvai
programme.desc: A retired veteran lawyer returns to defend three women falsely accused in a criminal case, facing powerful enemies and patriarchal biases in court.

programme.title: Kavan
programme.desc: A TV journalist goes against the orders of his corrupt and dishonest boss and helps a group of youngsters in their fight against a pesticide factory.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Devaki has a stepdaughter Arya. She is a caring mother. One unfortunate night Arya is brutally attacked. When the justice system fails them, she goes to great lengths to find justice for her daughter.

programme.title: Officer On Duty
programme.desc: A demoted inspector investigates a counterfeit jewelry ring and becomes stuck in a deadly crime web that endangers his life and testshiscourage.

programme.desc: After a Black father avenges his daughters brutal assault by killing her attackers, a young lawyer must defend him in a small Mississippi town deeply divided by racial tension and the Ku Klux Klan. (一位年轻律师必须在密西西比小城镇为他辩护,)

programme.desc: In Waterworld, Kevin Costner stars as a lone maverick in a flooded future Earth, protecting a mother and daughter from a tribe of ruthless nomads. Dennis Hopper delivers a memorable villainous performance in this thrilling adventure. (在水世界中,凯文·科斯特纳(Kevin Costner)明星作为未来被淹没的地球的独一独行者,保护母亲和女儿免遭无情的游牧部落的伤害。 丹尼斯·霍伯(Dennis Hopper)在这场令人惊叹的冒险中做出了令人难忘的恶作剧。)

programme.desc: A bookworm becomes the librarian. (书呆子成为图书管理员。 当天晚上,魔法长矛被偷走,他为了在全球寻找长矛而去寻找一些真正的生活经验,首先是被他的可爱助手从亚马孙上空从飞机上扔下来。)

programme.desc: Sue starts her Alaskan adventure in Anchorage, Americas last frontier, to see if she has what it takes to survive in the wilderness a place of adventure, beauty, and danger. (苏开始阿拉斯加的冒险 在安克雷奇,美洲最后的边界, 看看她是否有能力 在荒野中生存)

programme.title: Big Adventures: Into the Amazon with Robson Green (大冒险:与Robson Green一起进入亚马逊)
programme.desc: Robson explores the stunningly beautiful Anavilhanas Archipelago in his canoe. An intricate pattern of tiny islands and lagoons, its a truly magical place, teeming with fish and bird life. (Robson在其独木舟中探索了惊人美丽的Anavilhanas群岛。一个由小岛和环礁湖组成的复杂模式,它是一个真正神奇的地方,充满了鱼类和鸟类的生命。)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: Actress Michelle Rodriguez and Bear Grylls head to the Nevada. Unexpected high winds during a sky-diving trip send Michelle off course finally the duo must come up with clever ways to stay hydrated. (Michelle Rodriguez和Bear Grylls的女演员们前往内华达州。 一场空中潜水旅行的意外高风让Michelle偏离航线,最终二人组必须想出聪明的方法保持水分。)

programme.title: Hippo Watch with Steve Backshall (Steve Backshall的河马观察)
programme.desc: Having learnt where a hippos aggression comes from Steve wants to find out if we can live alongside the animal that kills up to 500 people a year. He visits St.Lucia, a town where hippos roam the streets freely at night, feeding on the manicured lawns and bushes of the townsfolk. In order to see them out of the water he must come back at night. (学会了史蒂夫对河马的侵犯后,想了解我们是否可以与每年造成500人死亡的动物一起生活。 他访问了圣卢西亚,该镇的河马晚上可以自由游荡街头,在城镇的修剪草坪和灌木丛上吃东西。 为了让他们走出水面,他必须在晚上回来。)

programme.title: Portillos Andalucia ((安達盧西亞深度遊))
programme.desc: In Granada, Michael Portillo meets a food writer and tries his hand at a potters wheel. (在格拉纳达,迈克尔·波蒂洛遇到了一位食品作家,)

programme.title: The Worlds Deadliest Weather ((世界最致命的天气))
programme.desc: A historic flood wipes out Valencia, Oregons third largest wildfire, and the deadliest hurricane to hit U.S. in almost 20 years. (瓦伦西亚发生历史性洪水, 威尼斯人州第三大森林火灾,)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: Actress Michelle Rodriguez and Bear Grylls head to the Nevada. Unexpected high winds during a sky-diving trip send Michelle off course finally the duo must come up with clever ways to stay hydrated. (Michelle Rodriguez和Bear Grylls的女演员们前往内华达州。 一场空中潜水旅行的意外高风让Michelle偏离航线,最终二人组必须想出聪明的方法保持水分。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter. (也见证了11月一些最不可思议的自然事件, 从数以百万计的美王蝴蝶聚集在墨西哥的森林里, 到笼罩迪拜城的深雾中,)

programme.title: Big Cat Country ((狮子王国))
programme.desc: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomads brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey. (好莱坞的自豪感在游牧民野蛮袭击其领导人艾娃后再次出现,使她处于绝望的弱势,无法打猎。 更糟糕的是,她饥饿的骄傲开始拒绝她。 但是没有她,他们就为击败猎物而斗争。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom. (看着利隆圭野生动物团队试图释放两只保护猫。 一只猫逃出,然后受伤。 释放它们是否成功? 一个新的婴儿动脉在危急条件下到达,一只巨型猫头鹰飞向自由。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poachers snare. Meanwhile, the centers resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery. (加入Amanda的白拳灌木丛冒险活动,拯救被偷猎者偷猎的水桶。 与此同时,土狼收容中心被跳蚤咬耳朵治疗,而Alma却在深夜被神秘的猴子送来。)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera. (在南澳大利亚州执行一个危险的拖拖任务,该任务将展示鲨鱼吃什么,为什么它们聚集在热点地区。 然后,当一个团队向北追赶老虎、公牛和锤头鲨鱼,并装配一个带有360度双角相机的鲨鱼。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches. (在一片迷雾的南非森林里,长了6百年的奥特尼夸黄木。在40米高的地方,她高在树冠上,是她这一类人中仅有的少数。 顺从她那迷人的故事,她的树枝是独特的生态系统。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga. (北半球进入了秋天,而澳大利亚则见证了生命的重生,而交配的座头鲸填满了汤加温暖的热带海洋。)

programme.title: Jaguar Journals (捷日志)
programme.desc: Feel the heat as Lizzie and veterinarian Joares scramble to collar more jaguars amid storms, floods, and power outages. Try to pin down the elusive Badalo before his data-gathering tag drops off and meet a new female the team is eager to study. (利兹和兽医乔亚雷斯在暴风雨、洪水和停电中争吵着把更多的美洲虎锁起来。 在巴达洛的数据收集标签掉下来之前,先把他的难以捉摸的巴达洛钉住,然后见到一支新女性,小组渴望学习。)

programme.title: Big Cat Country ((狮子王国))
programme.desc: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK prides territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Avas survival skills are still intact. (游牧民族的骄傲狂妄的狮子们深入了MK骄傲的领地中心,分散了其成员,危险地接近了5个新的MK幼崽。 与此同时,好莱坞正在恢复,阿瓦斯的生存技能依然未变。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs. (在动物王国最强大的动物国的强大力量中,巴斯克(Bask)最强大。 以银背大猩猩的岩石硬石白蚁猎犬,用银背大猩猩击打,看到能够粉碎caiman头骨的美洲虎,然后前往海洋见证猎豹群。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey. (随着地球最快的动物运动员的击球, 观看死亡鱼在瞬间袭击, 用鱼进行空中暗杀, 与马龙一起快速吃饭,)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner. (跟踪大堡礁沿岸的一头怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她是否带领一组科学家到她隐藏的抽水场。 然后在南部海岸寻找交配的迹象,这些迹象可能暴露出一个非常害羞的雌性巨型巨型巨型猎物,以寻找伴侣。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year. (在南非纳马夸兰的一个岩石山坡上扎根的Namaqua Rock Fig树站着。 它是终极生存者,能够在每年面临气温不断上升和降雨量越来越少的风景中忍受无情的环境条件。)

Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy. (观察Onfari 团队了解了Aroeira, 也就是他们新被囚禁的女性Aroeira, 并查看了Apolo的Auroras 幼崽。 继续追踪Badalo,他已经深入到洪水泛滥的森林,在那里他将利兹改变游戏的研究置于危险之中。)

programme.title: 내 몸을 부탁해

programme.title: 톡파원 25시

programme.title: 중독자들

programme.title: 이혼숙려캠프

programme.title: 좋은아침

programme.title: 생방송 투데이

programme.title: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 그날 이야기
programme.desc: 눈길을 사로잡는 그 날, 그 사건으로부터 한 사람의 소시민으로서 내가 느낀 바를, 온전히 나의 시점에서 주관적으로 전달한다. 너 에게 꼭 들려주고 싶어! 친구, 배우자, 동료... 세 명의 이야기꾼이 스스로 공부하며 느낀 바를 각자의 이야기 친구가장 가까운 지인에게, 가장 일상적인 공간에서 1:1 로 전달한다.

programme.title: 생생정보 스페셜

programme.title: 인간극장 스페셜

programme.title: 광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: Innu-aimun Policier autochtone
programme.desc: Innu-aimun, Uashat and Pessamit Wendake, les policiers doivent faire de la prvention pour contrer livresse au volant lors dun tournoi de hockey. Wemotaci, deux policiers partent la recherche dun membre de la communaut vis par un mandat.

programme.title: Innu-aimun Sur Le Terrain
programme.desc: Innu-aimun An Atikamekw patient navigator accompanies a patient to a medical appointment, and an interpreter in Sept-les visits a patient who has been hospitalized for several months since falling and losing the use of his legs.

programme.title: Anishinaabemowin Pow Wow Chow
programme.desc: Anishinaabemowin, Odawa Struggling to leave new friends behind, Shawn and Whitney load up and head for the Hillside Music Festival. Meanwhile, Bob and Rhonda recruit some unsuspecting relatives and make their way to a busy powwow.

programme.title: Anishinaabemowin Taken
programme.desc: Anishinaabemowin Ashley Morin disappeared from North Battleford in 2018, and the RCMP suspect homicide. Her family honours her memory with awareness walks, determined to find justice and answers while police continue to investigate the case.

programme.title: Cree Squamish Medium
programme.desc: Cree, PlainsA reading with a fitness trainer grieving the loss of her dad prompts Danielle to confront her own father.As Danielle and her dad heal old wounds,she must decide whether she is ready for him to see her work as a medium for first time.

programme.title: Cree Unsettled Spirits
programme.desc: Cree, PlainsJesi Whittons team is called to the Sunflower Cafe, where owners Sym and Kathy have faced years of poltergeist activity. But now a darker entity has arrived-one that watches, creeps close, and makes them feel unsafe for the first time.

programme.title: Halkomelem Nations at War
programme.desc: Halkomelem From their original home in Europes far north, the Vikings carved out a kingdom with the point of the sword. But their dreams of a Canadian colony met a violent end at the hands of the mysterious Skrlings, who refused to surrender.

programme.title: Halkomelem Nations at War
programme.desc: HalkomelemWar in the forests of the Dawnland was fast, brutal and intimate, a hard lesson that the Wabanaki Confederacy warriors taught their British enemies.The British looked to the First Nations to create a new soldier for a new war: the ranger.

programme.title: Halkomelem Nations at War
programme.desc: Halkomelem In the 1800s, Great Britain laid claim to the Salish Sea. To preserve their land and sovereignty, the Coast Salish nations challenged the Royal Navy, the mightiest naval power of the day.The British responded with overwhelming firepower.
